probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,f As PivotField,other As PivotField
Set ws=Worksheets(1)
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value=Array("Region","Category","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value=Array("West","B",20)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value=Array("East","A",10)
ws.Range("A4:C4").Value=Array("East","B",30)
ws.Range("A5:C5").Value=Array("West","A",40)
ws.Range("A6:C6").Value=Array("East","A",50)
On Error GoTo Failed
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:C6"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("F5"),"Made")
p.PivotFields("Region").Orientation=xlRowField
p.AddDataField p.PivotFields("Amount"),"Total",xlSum
p.AddDataField p.PivotFields("Amount"),"Mean",xlAverage
Set f=p.DataPivotField
f.Orientation=xlRowField
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
Probe="name=" & f.Name
Probe=Probe & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Probe=Probe & "|axis=" & CStr(f.Orientation)
Probe=Probe & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Probe=Probe & "|pos=" & CStr(f.Position)
Probe=Probe & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Probe=Probe & "|label=" & f.LabelRange.Address
Probe=Probe & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Probe=Probe & "|data=" & f.DataRange.Address
Probe=Probe & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)

Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
